subject.title: [AI-assisted] Preserve thread sessions across daily reset by default

question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessionClosedAt` as a durable core-owned `SessionEntry` field and reserved plugin slot for closed thread rollover?
rationale: The code path is coherent and tested, but persisted session fields and plugin slot reservations are compatibility-sensitive and need maintainer ownership of the long-term contract.

options.title: Accept durable marker
options.body: Merge this contract after owner review, keeping the current tests/docs as the compatibility proof for closed-thread rollover.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller internal/plugin-owned signal if maintainers do not want another durable core session field.

options.title: Pause for session-state design
options.body: Hold the PR until the broader session-store ownership direction is settled, accepting that the closed-thread rollover bug remains open meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Accept durable marker
recommendation.body: Merge this contract after owner review, keeping the current tests/docs as the compatibility proof for closed-thread rollover.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session management and gateway/session history make this the best available owner for the durable session-state contract decision.
